meta.name: bgpt-paper-search
meta.description: Search scientific papers and retrieve structured experimental data extracted from full-text studies via the BGPT MCP server. Returns 25+ fields per paper including methods, results, sample sizes, quality scores, and conclusions. Use for literature reviews, evidence synthesis, and finding experimental details not available in abstracts alone.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索科学论文并提取结构化实验数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要从全文论文中快速获取实验数据细节。
copy.tagline_en: Search papers and extract structured experimental data.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need detailed experimental data from full-text papers.

howto.what: Claude 会通过 BGPT MCP 服务器调用 search_papers 工具搜索科学论文,返回每篇论文的方法、定量结果、样本量、质量评分等 25 项以上结构化字段,而不仅是标题和摘要。
howto.when: 当用户要求查找带具体实验细节的论文、做文献综述或证据综合、或获取摘要之外的实验数据时触发。

say.text: 帮我搜索CRISPR基因编辑在人类细胞中的效率相关论文
say.note: Claude 会调用 BGPT 返回结构化结果

say.text: 找几篇比较不同研究方法的论文,要包含样本量
say.note: 可获取多篇论文的方法与样本量对比

say.text: 整理这些论文的质量评分和结论,用于证据综合
say.note: 返回质量评分、结论等字段

howto.what_en: Claude will search scientific papers via the BGPT MCP server and return structured data per paper — methods, quantitative results, sample sizes, quality scores, and 25+ metadata fields — instead of just titles and abstracts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to search for papers with specific experimental details, conduct a literature review or evidence synthesis, or retrieve experimental data not found in abstracts.

say_en.text: Search for papers about CRISPR gene editing efficiency in human cells
say_en.note: Claude calls BGPT and returns structured results.

say_en.text: Find papers comparing different study methods, including sample sizes
say_en.note: Gets methods and sample sizes across studies.

say_en.text: Compile quality scores and conclusions from these papers for evidence synthesis
